renderedHtml:
UNESCO World Heritage
Necropolis Solar Ship Archeo-astronomy Conservation
Memphis & Its Necropolis

The Great
Pyramids of Giza

A testament to monolithic limestone architecture and exact archeo-astronomy alignment. Experience the timeless sandstone thermal mass that has endured millennia under the desert sun.

Architectural Telemetry

Dataset: Khufu Complex

SCAN_01

Structural Topography

Engineered with microscopic precision. The original highly polished limestone casing stones acted as a mirrored beacon across the ancient sands.

2.3M Stone Blocks
5.9M Tons Mass
True North Error margin: 0.05°

Cosmic alignment targeting the constellation of Orion.

20°C Internal Temp

Constant thermal mass regardless of desert fluctuations.

Khufu’s Solar Ship

Sealed in a bedrock pit, this intact vessel was engineered to carry the resurrected king across the heavens.

Dimensions 43.6m × 5.9m

Preserving the resonance
of human endeavor.

The exactitude of the stonework stands as a masterpiece of heritage engineering transcending the boundaries of time.
